description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility, facilitating log message routing and chaining within a logging framework.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode to wrap Android's native Log utility, enabling log message chaining and customization.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, then passes it to the next node if available.
